goal: Pursue causal conditional means under explicit structural uncertainty, not merely a different optimizer. Brain analogies motivate hypotheses and confer no evidence.

sparse.reason: v6 development stationary gain7.68%, one-change full-stream gain4.25%, recurrence regression15.99% versus v3. Its factorized parameter beliefs and posterior-mass pruning remain approximations. Learning hazard weights did not make the model family adequate.
sparse.within_segment_prior: Exactly mutually exclusive null or one predictive coordinate. p(null)=1/2; p(k)=1/(2D). sigma^2~IG(alpha0=2,beta0=1); theta_k|sigma^2~N(0,sigma^2). This is specialized structural knowledge, not a generic optimizer advantage.
sparse.sufficient_statistics: Per segment n,sum_y2 scalars; sum_x2,sum_xy vectors[D], FP64. alpha=2+n/2; precision_k=1+sum_x2_k; m_k=sum_xy_k/precision_k; beta_null=1+sum_y2/2; beta_k=beta_null-sum_xy_k*m_k/2. Null-relative log Bayes factor=-log(precision_k)/2-alpha*log1p(-sum_xy_k*m_k/(2*beta_null)). Normalize over null and all D alternatives jointly.
sparse.prediction: Past support probabilities weight m_k*x_k. Exact within-segment posterior predictive Student-t has df=2*alpha, location=m_k*x_k, scale^2=(beta_k/alpha)*(1+x_k^2/precision_k); null has location0 and scale^2=beta_null/alpha. Score its normalized mixture before adding the label to statistics. No label-dependent forecast, EMA noise approximation, arbitrary floors, or finite-failure fallback.
sparse.change_inference: Four hazard children(0,1e-5,1e-4,1e-3), uniform hyperprior,32 retained run-length representatives each. Pre-label existing-branch mass(1-h)*w plus fresh prior mass h; condition on each branch predictive density once. Preserve all posterior mass by grouping retained candidates plus birth into floor(log(age)/log(1.5)) buckets (age starts1; 32 buckets cover60000). Within each occupied bucket select a representative by posterior-mass-proportional categorical resampling and assign it the sum of bucket mass. Empty buckets have zero mass. This is stochastic run-length compression, NOT an exact global posterior. Keep integer birth times and sample with independent pre-generated uniforms, whose bytes and consumption are authenticated.
sparse.structural_hedge: The exact singleton model is misspecified for two simultaneous signals. Primary forecast averages its four-hazard mixture and the frozen v6 factorized four-hazard mixture with equal structural prior, updated once by their pre-label predictive mixture densities. This permits the less restrictive model to win without looking at ground-truth support. Keep a standalone singleton top-mass budget32,h=1e-4 control to isolate mass-preserving compression. Reuse the frozen v6 model; never modify it.
sparse.outputs: Primary structural mixture; singleton hazard mixture and all four children; singleton top-mass h=1e-4; frozen v6 hazard mixture and its children; v3 likelihood-static; zero; original prefix-selected AdamW; legacy Adam1e-5. Publish all, not only the winning branch.
sparse.evaluation: Reuse v6 full60000,D4096,Bernoulli.01,Gaussian noise1 protocols and five views stationary/change/null/recurrent/two_support. Seed1. Development namespace0; new confirmation namespace300. Original v5 AdamW prefix lock is validated before draws. Resampling has a separate explicitly declared RNG namespace, never the data generator. All updates, validations, raw forecasts, traces, and checkpoints reach60000 or the result fails/records interruption honestly. No learning-budget culling.
sparse.proof: Independent small-D batch NIG posterior and Student-t predictive-density comparisons; absence-of-feature behavior; full mass conservation and hand-chosen categorical resampling; zero hazard static equivalence; pre-label forecast invariance; repeated graph/capture restore including randomness clocks; no mutation from mean_weights; imported-lock rejection; exhaustive Bernoulli risk; final-row trace and complete sample consumption. Skip brittle source-text tests.
sparse.promotion: Fresh namespace300 change and recurrence clean MSE at least20% below v3; stationary and two-support no more than5% worse; null clean MSE<=1e-5. Report per-view failures. No global-optimality, equal-compute, generic-optimizer or PPO claim. Explicitly cost the additional model capacity.

returns.hierarchical_model: Gaussian unit-noise linear model beta_i~N(beta_global,lambda_local^-1 I), beta_global~N(0,lambda_global^-1 I). Exact posterior mean within this declared STATIC model, not a proven market model. For each stock/prior maintain P_i=(lambda_local I+sum xx')^-1 and m_i=P_i sum xy. P initially I/lambda_local and m0. Pre-update beta_global=(B+lambda_global I)^-1 q, beta_i=m_i+lambda_local P_i beta_global. Initially B=0,q=0. With u=P_i x,d=1+x'u,e=y-x'm_i: P_i-=uu'/d; m_i+=u*e/d; B+=lambda_local^2 sum_valid uu'/d; q+=lambda_local sum_valid u*e/d. Invalid observations do not update local state or shared information. All forecasts precede these updates. Accumulate positive B increments rather than subtracting near-equal matrices. FP64 inference, explicit finite/solver health, no hidden covariance repair.
